name: tw.com.ecpay.paymentgatewaykit.core.other.CertificateErrorActivity
description: The ECPay (綠界科技) Payment Gateway SDK opens this screen when a payment request encounters a certificate error. It shows the error details and lets the user retry the payment flow or close the screen.
disableEffect: Users may be unable to see a certificate error or retry or close the affected ECPay payment flow.
